# Checkbox

Checkbox — single boolean control with optional indeterminate state. Supports controlled (`isChecked`) and uncontrolled (`defaultChecked`) usage. Built on Base UI's Checkbox: a `role="checkbox"` span with a hidden native input beside it for form submission, wrapped in `FieldFrame` (A7) for the label and the description caption. `isInvalid` marks the unselected box only, through `data-invalid` scoped off `data-checked` in the stylesheet.

Also asked as: multi-select, checklist, tick box.

## Usage

Use `Checkbox` when a person needs to select one or more options from a list of related items, or when a setting needs an explicit confirmation before it applies. Checkboxes let a person choose many options, or none, from a short list they can see whole, and a parent checkbox shows the mixed (`isIndeterminate`) state while some of its children are selected.

## Motion

Checkbox reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does | Sound |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| change | Update a value or state | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Mark and fill change color. |  |
| goal | Update a value or state | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | A session goal set or checked off together: the mark and fill change color, like any change. | `sound.goal` on land: only the session goal check-in done together, shared with the student; other checkboxes stay silent |

## Alternatives

- For a question offering a list of checkboxes under a shared legend and error, use `CheckboxGroup`.
- For a setting that takes effect immediately without submitting a form, use `Toggle`.
- For mutually exclusive answers where only one may be chosen, use `RadioGroup` or `Radio`.
- For a long list of multi-select options, use `Select` with `isMulti`.
- For a rows-by-columns matrix of checkboxes, use `ChoiceGrid`.

## Best practices

### Reserve choice tiles for one big question with two to four pictured options. {#reserve-choice-tiles-for-one-big-question-with-two-to-four-pictured-options}

Use `appearance="tile"` when a step asks one focal question with two to four options and every option carries an `illustration`. Keep ordinary form lists and sets of five or more options in `plain` or `card`.

Do: Two pictured tiles with top-end checkboxes for one focal question.
Don't: Plain text options without illustrations drawn as tiles.

### Say what is being agreed to. {#say-what-is-being-agreed-to}

The label states the commitment in a full phrase. "Yes" or "OK" hides what the person is accepting.

Do: The label names the agreement.
Don't: The label says nothing about what is accepted.

### Keep the label beside the box, in sentence case. {#keep-the-label-beside-the-box-in-sentence-case}

Sentence case reads as a statement. All caps and a trailing period read as a warning.

Do: Sentence case, no period.
Don't: All caps with a period.

### Keep each label to one line. {#keep-each-label-to-one-line}

A short label sits level with the box. A long one wraps and pushes the box away from its first line.

Do: One short line.
Don't: A label that wraps into a paragraph.

### Name the choice, not the instruction. {#name-the-choice-not-the-instruction}

Do: The label names the choice.
Don't: The label tells the person what to do with the box.

### Explain an invalid box; do not disable it. {#explain-an-invalid-box-do-not-disable-it}

Do: The invalid box keeps full contrast and stays in the tab order.
Don't: A disabled box cannot be tabbed to.

### Use read-only for fixed answers and disabled for unavailable ones. {#use-read-only-for-fixed-answers-and-disabled-for-unavailable-ones}

`isReadOnly` shows an answer that cannot be changed: the box stays in the tab order at full contrast with no hover (`aria-readonly`), ignores clicks and Space, and takes the neutral fill when unchecked. `isDisabled` removes it from the tab order and grays it when a prerequisite on the same screen is unmet. Put the reason in `description`, which stays at full contrast, never a tooltip. When it blocks the main action or several boxes, add a warning `SectionMessage` above that says how to turn them on. See [Read-only](?path=/docs/patterns-states-read-only--docs) and [Disabled](?path=/docs/patterns-states-disabled--docs).

### Keep extra detail in `description`. {#keep-extra-detail-in-description}

`description` renders under the label and is wired with `aria-describedby`, so it is read after the name.

### Pick controlled or uncontrolled and stay there. {#pick-controlled-or-uncontrolled-and-stay-there}

```jsx
// Incorrect: `isChecked` being defined puts the component in controlled mode,
// which makes `defaultChecked` dead. The two never apply together.
<Checkbox id="terms" label="I accept" isChecked={accepted} defaultChecked />

// Correct: controlled needs a handler; uncontrolled needs neither.
<Checkbox id="terms" label="I accept" isChecked={accepted} onChange={onAccept} />
```

### Treat `isIndeterminate` as display only. {#treat-isindeterminate-as-display-only}

The underlying value is still checked or unchecked. Clicking a mixed box resolves it like any other, so it cannot be used as a third stored value.

## Accessibility

- **Label association.** The component derives an id for the input and label automatically; pass `aria-label` only when there is no visible label.
- **Do not disable a box that must stay reachable.** Use `isInvalid` with a message linked by `aria-describedby`, so a screen reader user hears why the option cannot be chosen. Include an error message for a required or invalid box, for example "Select an option".
- **`isRequired` sets `aria-required` on the checkbox**, whether or not `labelMarker="required"` is shown for a minority required field.
- **`isIndeterminate` is set on the DOM node** and announced as "mixed".
- **Keyboard.** `Space` toggles the focused checkbox; `Enter` does not. Keyboard focus is a 2px ring on `border.focused`, 2px off the box; pointer focus draws none.

- `ChoiceGrid`: use when asking the same checkbox question across multiple rows.
- `Select`: use when choosing from a long list of options (`isMulti`).

## Parts

1. **Box.** An 18 square with a 2px edge in `plain`, `card` and `tile`; visually hidden in `soft` while keeping native checkbox semantics, keyboard navigation, and form submission.
2. **Label.** 14/20 text beside the box in a 24 row. It names the checkbox. An optional minority marker (`"(optional)"` or `"(required)"`) follows it in plain text.
3. **Description.** Optional 12/16 text under the label that describes the choice. It does not name it.
4. **Appearances.** `plain` draws the box and label inline; `card` wraps them in a bordered surface row; `soft` draws a `--ds-background-neutral` row without a checkbox box (selected row shows `--ds-background-selected`, a 1px `--ds-border-selected` edge, and a trailing `fa-solid fa-check` icon) for the majority selection type in a choice flow while the minority selection type keeps its visible control; `tile` draws a 224px pictured card with the checkbox at the top end.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | `--ds-background-input` fill with a `--ds-border-input` edge; in `soft`, `--ds-background-neutral` fill with no border. |
| Hovered | Unselected: `--ds-background-input-hovered` with a `--ds-border-brand` edge (or `--ds-background-neutral-hovered` in `soft`). Selected: the hovered step of the selected bold fill (or `--ds-background-selected-hovered` in `soft`). |
| Pressed | In `soft`, an unselected row takes `--ds-background-neutral-pressed` and a selected row takes `--ds-background-selected-pressed`. |
| Focused | A 2px ring in `--ds-border-focused`, 2px off the box (or around the row in `soft` and `tile`), for keyboard focus only. |
| Selected | `--ds-background-selected-bold` fill and `--ds-border-selected` edge; the check is `--ds-icon-inverse`. In `soft`, `--ds-background-selected` fill, 1px `--ds-border-selected` edge, and a trailing check in `--ds-icon-selected`. |
| Mixed | The same fill and edge as selected; the mark is a dash in `--ds-icon-inverse` (or `fa-solid fa-minus` in `--ds-icon-selected` in `soft`). |
| Invalid | The unselected box or tile takes `--ds-border-danger` (in `soft`, both unselected and selected rows take `--ds-border-danger`). |
| Read-only | Full contrast, in the tab order, `aria-readonly`, no hover; an unchecked box takes the `--ds-background-neutral` fill. Ignores clicks and Space. |
| Disabled | `--ds-background-disabled` fill, `--ds-border-disabled` edge, `--ds-icon-disabled` mark. Out of the tab order. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Box fill | `--ds-background-input`; selected `--ds-background-selected-bold`. |
| Box edge | `--ds-border-input`; selected `--ds-border-selected`; invalid `--ds-border-danger`. |
| Box size, radius | `--checkbox-control-size` (18); `--radius-md`; `--border-width-selected` edge. |
| Row | `--control-sm` (24); gap `--inline-md`. |
| Label | `--ds-text`, body default. |
| Focus ring | `--ds-border-focused`, 2px, 2px offset. |
| Soft row | `--radius-control-md`, `--ds-background-neutral` fill at rest; selected `--ds-background-selected` fill, `--border-width-default` `--ds-border-selected` edge, and `--icon-sm` trailing check in `--ds-icon-selected`. |
| Choice tile | `--choice-tile-width` (224px), `--radius-control-md`, `--ds-surface` fill; selected 2px `--ds-border-selected` and `--ds-background-selected`, with the Checkbox at the top end. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Write the label as the choice: "Email me a summary". | An instruction: "Check this box to receive an email summary." |
| Use sentence case and no end punctuation. | Title case, or a period after the label. |
| Phrase every label in the positive: "Send reminders". | A negative that makes selecting mean "no": "Do not send reminders". |
| Say what to do in an error: "Select an option". | "Required" or "Invalid". |
| Put extra detail in the description: "Sent the evening before." | Stretch the label into a sentence. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | The `id` of the checkbox; the label points at it. Generated when omitted. |
| `name` | string | — | The form key the box submits under, and sent in the `onChange` payload. |
| `label` | node | — | Text that names the checkbox |
| `value` | string or number | — | The value submitted with a form when the box is selected, and sent in the `onChange` payload. |
| `isChecked` | bool | — | Whether the box is selected. Pass it, with `onChange`, to control the checkbox. |
| `defaultChecked` | bool | — | Whether the box starts selected, when `isChecked` is not controlling it. |
| `isIndeterminate` | bool | `false` | Mixed state, for a parent of partly selected children |
| `isInvalid` | bool | `false` | Marks the unselected box as failing validation |
| `isDisabled` | bool | `false` | Disable the checkbox |
| `isReadOnly` | bool | `false` | Shown and announced, not changeable |
| `labelMarker` | enum | — | Minority marker after the label |
| `isRequired` | bool | `false` | Set aria-required on the checkbox |
| `description` | node | — | Secondary text under the label. It describes the box and does not name it. |
| `illustration` | node | — | Decorative picture shown above the label when `appearance` is `tile`. |
| `appearance` | enum | `'plain'` | `plain` (default) draws the box and label inline; `card` draws a bordered row; `soft` draws a neutral row without a checkbox; `tile` draws a centered pictured tile with the checkbox at its top end. |
| `onChange` | func | — | Called with `{ target: { name, value, checked } }` when the box is toggled. |
| `onFocus` | func | — | Called with the focus event when the checkbox gains focus. |
| `onBlur` | func | — | Called with the blur event when the checkbox loses focus. |
| `onClick` | func | — | Called with the click event on the checkbox. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class names added to the field wrapper beside the component's own. |
| `style` | object | — | Inline styles for the field wrapper. |
| `testId` | string | — | Maps to `data-testid`, for test queries. |
